turns.user: I have a valid monthly Budapest pass. What else do I need to use 100E?
turns.agent:
If your monthly Budapest pass is valid and is not the monthly pass for job seekers, the 5 November 2026 fare snapshot says you can use 100E with the 1,000 HUF add-on airport shuttle ticket. The add-on is bought in BudapestGO and covers one 100E trip only; it does not cover transfers to other routes. If your pass is the job-seeker monthly pass, this add-on does not apply. Add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket · Full-price airport shuttle bus single ticket

If you don’t have an eligible pass or add-on, the snapshot lists the full-price 100E ticket at 2,500 HUF. Please check BKK’s current rules before travelling; this is a dated snapshot, not live verification. I can’t buy or issue tickets, but I can help check which option fits your exact pass.

turns.user: Does the 1,000 HUF add-on also cover a connecting tram after I leave 100E?
turns.agent: No. The 1,000 HUF 100E add-on covers one 100E trip only; it does not cover a connecting tram or any other route. Your monthly Budapest pass may cover the tram if it is valid for that service and journey, but the add-on itself doesn’t. This is according to the 5 November 2026 snapshot; check BKK’s current add-on airport shuttle ticket rules before travel.
